scope: Ninth and final backfill round for the current 42-municipality recovery set: Doesburg, Drimmelen, Dronten, Druten and Amsterdam. This completes v2 application-process coverage passes for all 42, while retaining legal/address/application questions that still require evidence before closure.

activities.permitOrProcedureName: current Omgevingsplan/omgevingsvergunning route where permission is required
conditionalDocuments: leges or tariff evidence is operational evidence only and is not treated as the substantive legal basis
exact documents follow from current substantive rule plus activity/address check

remainingLegalQuestions: current substantive source for ordinary room rental/splitting/housing-stock change
remainingApplicationQuestions: capture current housing-specific product/form if applicable after substantive source is established

activities.permitOrProcedureName: spatial/omgevingsvergunning route depending current Omgevingsplan and address
conditionalDocuments: project/address determines spatial and building attachments
target-group-specific rules must not be generalized to ordinary rental

remainingLegalQuestions: targeted current-source research for ordinary room rental and dwelling formation
remainingApplicationQuestions: representative address/activity validation and current product/form capture if applicable

activities.permitOrProcedureName: permission depending on current Omgevingsplan, activity and address
conditionalDocuments: address/activity validation determines whether permission and attachments are required
static municipality-wide attachment requirements are not inferred from generic building routes

remainingApplicationQuestions: representative address/activity validation and capture of resulting application requirements

activities.permitOrProcedureName: current policy/Omgevingsplan permission route depending address and activity
conditionalDocuments: policy applicability and address must be checked together
the live application route determines exact attachments where no current static municipal checklist is established

remainingApplicationQuestions: policy/address validation plus representative application-package capture

activities.permitOrProcedureName: activity-specific municipal housing-stock permit and/or Omgevingsplan/omgevingsvergunning route depending proposal and address
activities.submissionChannel: municipal digital permit route and/or Omgevingsloket depending activity
conditionalDocuments: Amsterdam requires activity-specific treatment: conversion/room rental, dwelling formation, withdrawal/merger and building/spatial permissions must not be collapsed into one generic application
geometry/address and applicable Omgevingsplan rules require validation
documents, drawings, liveability/technical substantiation and other evidence must be captured from the exact current permit product or Omgevingsloket result before product encoding

remainingApplicationQuestions: capture exact current application package per applicable housing-stock activity
capture current fees, authentication and decision periods per product

summary.nextPhase: synchronize central backlog and Excel; then close items only after required targeted/address/product QA
summary.qualityRule: 42/42 means every municipality received the v2 legal-plus-application backfill pass; it does not mean every open legal or address-dependent question is resolved.
